name: Record a coherent code change
short_description: Record one focused code change with a message that states its intent and scope.
self_assessment: I can record one coherent code change without help and restore its prior state.
description: Record one focused code change with a message that states its intent and scope. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Record and reverse a small source change
